# Waitloop

> Developer-native waiting layer for coding agents. Hooks report minimal lifecycle state; games fill short waits; work immediately takes priority again when the agent needs attention.

Canonical agent integration guide: https://waitloop.run/agent.md
Machine-readable manifest: https://waitloop.run/agent.json
Waitloop skill: https://waitloop.run/skills/waitloop/SKILL.md
Room API: https://waitloop.run/api/v1/rooms
Room-specific join pattern: https://waitloop.run/join/<join-code>
Game MCP endpoint: https://waitloop.run/mcp
CLI alpha install: npm install -g @waitloop/cli@alpha
Health: https://waitloop.run/api/v1/health
Source: https://github.com/shixushi2025/waitloop

Important model: a game Seat is distinct from an Actor. An Actor may control a Seat or advise a Seat. Advisors may inspect their explicitly bound Seat and comment but cannot play until the Seat owner delegates control.

Agents do not need the Web UI. Headless Agent + 2 bot rooms can be created with `POST /api/v1/rooms` using mode `agent-bots`, then joined through the returned code and controlled through room-scoped MCP.

Current MCP tools: get_turn(), play_move(expectedRevision, moveId), comment(text).

Lifecycle hooks and game MCP are separate. Hooks report running/waiting/completed/failed; game credentials are temporary room/Actor capabilities.
